## [3.0.1](https://github.com/R2bEEaton/walmart-morphe/compare/v3.0.0...v3.0.1) (2026-10-14)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* filter promo banners, hero carousels, and sponsored tiles in Remove Ads ([6d80878](https://github.com/R2bEEaton/walmart-morphe/commit/6d808787563a2990cc4166cf580964547a409a42))

patches.name: Default Lists Tab
patches.description: Opens the 'Lists' tab by default when tapping 'My Items' instead of the 'Reorder' tab.

patches.name: Find Item for Linked Items
patches.description: Restores the 'Find item' button on linked shopping list items so you can link a different product.

patches.name: Flash Everywhere
patches.description: Adds a dedicated 'Flash tag' sibling pill button next to Aisle indicators throughout the app to illuminate electronic shelf tags directly.

patches.name: Real-Time Stock & Inventory Display
patches.description: Displays real-time in-store stock availability badges on list and checklist items (e.g. In Stock, Low Stock / Only X left, Out of Stock).

patches.name: Remove Sponsored Ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored product carousels, banner ads, and promotional placements for a faster, cleaner app experience.

patches.name: Route My List
patches.description: Adds a 'Plan my route' map icon to the Walmart 'Shop in-store' checklist screen that opens Walmart's own in-store map with every list item's aisle pinned at once.
